title: Athletes ambition
desc:
Athlete's Ambition is a 12-week full-body strength and conditioning program designed to build functional strength, muscular endurance, stability, and athletic performance.

Built around three weekly gym sessions, the program combines compound lifts, unilateral movements, explosive exercises, and functional conditioning. Strength to perform. Endurance to last.

The goal is to develop a strong, capable, and resilient body prepared for everything from demanding days in the mountains to everyday physical challenges.

Train for performance. Build for longevity.

Does pair nicely with some slow zone 1-2 jogging on rest days. 
Just be mindful of your lower body recovery. Feel off? - Take a day off or a relaxed gym day.
